definitions.short: a kind of locust (from its destructiveness)
definitions.full: H5556. solam סָלְעָם noun masculine an edible, winged, locust (Late Hebrew id.; swallower, consumer , compare סַלְעֵם ᵑ7 swallow up, destroy ; Arabic verb swallow , Kö ii. 1, 404 ); — Lev 11:22 (+ חַגָב חַרְגֹּל, אַרְבֶּה, ).
definitions.rootNote: apparently from the same as 5553 in the sense of crushing as with a rock, i.e. consuming;
